info.title: SingIt API-key API
info.description: Create sk_singit_ keys in the app at https://app.singitai.app/app/. For x402 pay-per-call without a key, use https://ask.singitai.app/openapi.json. New keys carry answers, search and tools scopes; older keys may have answers only. Exa checks search; tools is checked for paid MCP tools, outside this REST API. Model routes do not separately check answers. Paid requests have a per-key limit of 60 requests/minute. Each key has a daily cap (reset at 00:00 UTC, including reservations for in-flight requests) and a per-request cap. Daily exhaustion returns 429 insufficient_quota; the per-minute limit returns 429 rate_limit_exceeded. Proxy estimates above the per-request cap return 400 over_request_limit. A nonempty Origin header returns 403 browser_request. Keep keys in server code. The proxy routes below exist in the gateway source; availability depends on server configuration, not a live deployment guarantee.

post.description: Works with or without the proxy. Without it, tools/functions are refused and streaming sends a completed answer as SSE rather than incremental generation. With the proxy, requests and streams are relayed. When configured with SIGN402_WEB_FREE_MODELS and an upstream key, free/<id> models use this route with authentication but no paid per-minute limit, daily cap reservation or balance charge. Free answers have separate configurable daily account/network/global quotas; defaults are 20/40/1000, with 400 output tokens and 4000 UTF-16 code units of message content. Tools/functions are refused. Counters are in memory and reset on restart; quotas reset at midnight UTC. Discover configured models and limits with GET /models. Exhaustion returns 429 free_limit_reached with Retry-After. Request format: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create. The schema lists fields read by the gateway; additional upstream fields are accepted. Model support depends on the selected model.

200.description: Return the upstream response format, or the gateway chat envelope. Billing fields may be added to successful JSON responses. The example body is an illustrative fragment: its text, token counts and charge are placeholder values, not a real answer, price or usage.
